description_en: Queries the UUIDs of assets for which proactive defense is effective based on the defense type
description_zh: 按照防御类型查询主动防御生效的资产的UUID列表
name: DescribeSuspiciousUUIDConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of proactive defense to query. Valid values:

auto_breaking: anti-virus
ransomware_breaking: anti-ransomware (bait capture)
webshell_cloud_breaking: web shell connection defense
alinet: malicious network behavior defense
alisecguard: client self-protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主动防御的防御类型。取值：

auto_breaking：防病毒
ransomware_breaking：防勒索（诱饵捕获）
webshell_cloud_breaking：网站后门连接防御
alinet：恶意网络行为防御
alisecguard：客户端自保护
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account). You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Count.description_en: The total number of servers for which the specified defense type is effective
Count.description_zh: 查询到该防御类型生效的服务器的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UUIDList.description_en: The UUIDs of the servers for which the specified defense type is effective
UUIDList.description_zh: 查询到的该防御类型生效的服务器的UUID列表

items.description_en: The UUID of the server for which the specified defense type is effective
items.description_zh: 查询到的该防御类型生效的服务器的UUID
